roles.title: Production Supervisor
roles.summary: Runs the daily production floor, ensuring food is made safely, on schedule, and to standard.

roles.title: EHS Manager
roles.summary: Ensures the plant is safe and compliant with government safety/environmental rules; investigates accidents and trains staff.

roles.title: Shipping Receiving Inventory Manager
roles.summary: Keeps track of everything coming into/out of the warehouse; plans daily loading/unloading; troubleshoots inventory issues.

roles.title: Maintenance Supervisor
roles.summary: Runs maintenance day to day; ensures equipment reliability and repairs stay on schedule; manages team and budget.
